hints.exp.scinot.write: The number in front is between 1 and 10. Count how many places the point moves: big numbers get a positive exponent, small numbers (less than 1) a negative one.
hints.exp.scinot.standard: × 10ⁿ moves the decimal point n places: right for positive n (bigger), left for negative n (smaller).
hints.exp.scinot.operate: Multiply (or divide) the numbers in front, then add (or subtract) the exponents of 10.
hints.exp.scinot: Front number between 1 and 10; the exponent counts how far the point moves.

misconceptionMessages.exp.sci-sign: Check the sign: numbers less than 1 have a negative exponent, big numbers a positive one.
misconceptionMessages.exp.sci-count-zeros: Count the places the decimal point moves, not the zeros: 45000 = 4.5 × 10⁴ (4 places).
misconceptionMessages.exp.sci-not-between: The number in front has to be at least 1 and less than 10.
misconceptionMessages.exp.sci-wrong-way: Positive exponent: the number gets bigger (point moves right). Negative: smaller (point moves left).
misconceptionMessages.exp.sci-off-by-one: Move the point exactly that many places: 4.5 × 10³ = 4500 (the 5 uses one of the places).

sections.title: Write in scientific notation
explain: Scientific notation writes very big and very small numbers as (a number from 1 to 10) × (a power of 10).
The exponent says how many places the decimal point moved.
sections.key: Number in front: at least 1, less than 10. Exponent: how many places the point moves. Big numbers positive, small numbers negative.

sections.title: Back to standard form
explain: Multiplying by 10 slides every digit one place left; × 10⁴ does it four times.
sections.key: × 10ⁿ moves the decimal point n places: right (bigger) for positive n, left (smaller) for negative n. Fill in zeros.

sections.title: Multiply and divide
sections.objective: Multiply and divide numbers in scientific notation.
explain: The numbers in front and the powers of 10 are handled separately.
sections.key: Multiply (or divide) the numbers in front. Add (or subtract) the exponents of 10.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Front number between 1 and 10; the exponent counts places. Multiply: add exponents. Divide: subtract.
